name: golden-orange-goddess-low-street
image_purpose: street-fashion campaign and editorial hero visual

prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic low-angle urban fashion hero portrait based on the approved character and clothing references, with wind movement and a teal-orange cinematic grade.
prompt.main_subject: Confident adult woman with wind-blown hair, direct gaze, red lips, and a powerful editorial attitude. She holds a fluttering magazine page in one hand and wears the approved clothing reference, preserving its silhouette, color, and material.
composition_elements: Full-body frame with an extreme low angle, camera below ankle level and tilted upward.
20–24mm ultra-wide perspective with dramatic near-far scale; shoes larger in foreground and legs leading toward the subject.
Subject stands in a power stance with a slight lean against a street pole.
Modern CBD street, glass skyscrapers, street lamps, traffic signs, white sports car, and a non-readable magazine billboard.
Wind-blown hair and paper create movement.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Golden-hour natural side-backlight from the right rear, warm rim light on hair and shoulders, cool ambient building fill, teal-orange contrast, soft golden highlight roll-off, cool teal shadows, subtle grain.
prompt.technical_specs: 8K photorealistic fashion editorial, 20–24mm wide-angle lens, deep depth of field, Classic Chrome-inspired color treatment, medium-high contrast, subtle grain, low-angle hero shot, no readable text or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Based on the approved character and clothing references, create a powerful confident adult woman with flowing hair dramatically blown by the wind, holding a fluttering non-readable magazine page in one hand. Direct confident gaze at camera, red lips, and an 'I own this city' editorial attitude. Standing with legs apart in a power stance, slight lean against a street pole. Full body with legs dominating the lower two-thirds, 20–24mm ultra-wide angle, extreme low angle with camera almost touching the ground, dramatic near-far perspective and leaning skyscrapers. Golden-hour side-backlight from the right rear, warm rim light on hair and shoulders, cool ambient fill from buildings, Fujifilm Classic Chrome-inspired teal-orange grade, subtle grain. Modern CBD urban street with glass skyscrapers, street lamps, traffic signs, white sports car and non-readable magazine billboard. 8K photorealistic wind-blown fashion editorial, deep depth of field, low-angle hero shot, no readable text, no watermark.
